args.query: SELECT c.name, c.email, SUM(o.qty * p.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
